Now put it together: one customer, one journey — sign in, add an item, check
out, and confirm the order. This is the test you tag as your smoke test later,
because when it is green the core of the shop works.

## Task 1 — Drive sign-in → cart → checkout → confirmation

**Goal:** create `checks/flow.robot` that signs in, adds a product, goes to
checkout, fills the form, places the order, and asserts it reads `complete`.

Here is the same journey for a different customer buying a different product.
Adapt it to `primary_user` adding the travel mug.

<!-- example -->
```robotframework
*** Settings ***
Library     Browser
Resource    ../resources/shop.resource

*** Test Cases ***
Reviewer Buys A Backpack
    New Browser    chromium    headless=True
    New Context
    New Page    ${BASE_URL}/login
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-username    reviewer_user
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-password    learning-password
    Click    data-testid=login-submit
    Click    data-testid=add-trail-backpack
    Get Text    data-testid=cart-heading    contains    Cart
    Click    data-testid=go-checkout
    Fill Text    data-testid=checkout-first    Grace
    Fill Text    data-testid=checkout-last    Hopper
    Click    data-testid=place-order
    Get Text    data-testid=order-status    ==    complete
    Close Browser
```
<!-- /example -->

**Check:** the suite defines `Customer Completes A Purchase`.

<!-- hint -->
After signing in, add the mug with `Click    data-testid=add-travel-mug`, then
confirm the cart with `Get Text    data-testid=cart-heading    contains    Cart`.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- hint -->
Go to checkout, fill `checkout-first` and `checkout-last`, `Click    data-testid=place-order`,
then assert `Get Text    data-testid=order-status    ==    complete`.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- solution -->
```robotframework
*** Settings ***
Library     Browser
Resource    ../resources/shop.resource

*** Test Cases ***
Customer Completes A Purchase
    New Browser    chromium    headless=True
    New Context
    New Page    ${BASE_URL}/login
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-username    primary_user
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-password    learning-password
    Click    data-testid=login-submit
    Click    data-testid=add-travel-mug
    Get Text    data-testid=cart-heading    contains    Cart
    Click    data-testid=go-checkout
    Fill Text    data-testid=checkout-first    Ada
    Fill Text    data-testid=checkout-last    Lovelace
    Click    data-testid=place-order
    Get Text    data-testid=order-status    ==    complete
    Close Browser
```
<!-- /solution -->

## Task 2 — Run the full journey green

Run:

```bash
uv run robot checks
```

**Check:** the purchase journey ends with `order-status` reading `complete`.
